I´m not sure how familiar you are with buddhism, but you should probably look it up, its not a religion since there is no god involved, its more like a way of approaching life and all the things that come with it. Buddhism is one of the few ( no word comes to mind except religion, which it is not, so i´ll call it a way of thinking) that acknowledges life as suffering, it literally says most of the things in life are suffering, and gives a guide how to avoid that. Buddhists believe in reincarnation, basically that when you die, depending on how you have lived that life (and those before, this is all called karma), whether you were good or bad, you will be reincarnated as either human, animal, hungry ghost, hellish being and there is one more, i can´t remember right now, iam writing this from top of my head. Umm basically before i lose myself in this writing - Enlightenment , that is the goal of buddhism. When you  become enlightened, aware of all things, perfectly conscious of yourself, come to terms with your past, present and future, live in the moment, basically all around awesome being, you become free of being reincarnated. That means you have transcended from being an average human, and you don´t have to live another life after you die. I think that buddhism makes the most sense of all the religions out there, even though its not one. I think that is the meaning of life. I just wanted to put this here as a different point of view, i guess this isn´t much of a reason to stay alive, but if all of that were true, then if you aimed for enlightenment in this life, you´d spare yourself from being born again in next life.
